en.name: Pumpkin seeds, raw, in the shell
en.summary: Raw pumpkin seeds still in their white hulls keep 6 months in a cool, dry cupboard. The hull is a real barrier against air, so these are a straightforward pantry item — no refrigeration figure is published and none is needed.
en.pantry: 6 months in an airtight jar, cool, dark and dry. The pale fibrous hull keeps most of the oxygen away from the green kernel inside, which is why in-shell seeds behave like an ordinary dry store-cupboard good. Nothing grows in them as long as they stay dry; what limits them is the kernel's oil slowly oxidising, and that shows up as bitterness rather than as anything visible. Keep the jar away from the hob and out of the sun.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for in-shell pumpkin seeds, and they do not need one. The hull is already doing the work, and a sealed jar in a cool cupboard reaches the published figure without taking up fridge space. If your kitchen is persistently hot and humid, chilling them does no harm — just seal them properly and let the jar warm before opening so condensation does not soften the hulls.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Freezing does not damage the seeds, since there is very little water in them, but with a hull-protected seed and a 6-month cupboard life there is very little to gain. A bulk sack is the only case worth the space, double-bagged with the air pressed out.
en.thawing: Nothing to thaw. If seeds have been kept cold, let the sealed container reach room temperature before opening.
spoilage: A bitter or fishy taste in the kernel when you crack a few open.
Hulls that are stained, blotchy or visibly mouldy.
A musty, damp smell from the jar.
Webbing, moths or grubs — pantry insects like seeds.
tips: Crack a few from different parts of the bag before committing to a batch.
Keep them dry above all; a damp jar is the one way these go genuinely bad.
Hull them only as you need them — the kernel keeps much less well on its own.
Label the jar with the purchase date; seeds look the same for months.

faq.q: How long do in-shell pumpkin seeds keep?
faq.a: 6 months in an airtight jar in a cool, dry, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Do pumpkin seeds in the shell need refrigerating?
faq.a: No refrigerated timeline is published and none is needed. The hull keeps air off the kernel, so a sealed jar in a cupboard is enough.

faq.q: How can you tell if pumpkin seeds have gone bad?
faq.a: Crack a few and taste the kernels. Rancid seeds are bitter and slightly fishy. Stained hulls or a musty smell mean the jar goes.

zh.name: 帶殼生南瓜籽
zh.summary: 還帶著白色外殼的生南瓜籽，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6 個月。那層殼是實實在在的隔氣屏障，所以它就是單純的櫥櫃食材——沒有公布冷藏期限，也不需要。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月。那層帶纖維的淡色外殼把大部分氧氣擋在裡面那顆綠色種仁之外，這就是為什麼帶殼南瓜籽的表現像個普通乾貨。只要保持乾燥，裡面長不出東西；限制它的是種仁的油脂慢慢氧化，而那會表現成苦味，不是看得見的變化。罐子請遠離爐台、避免日曬。
zh.fridge: 帶殼南瓜籽沒有冷藏的期限數據，它也不需要。殼已經在做這件事了，密封罐放陰涼櫥櫃就能走到公布的數字，不必占冰箱空間。如果廚房長期又熱又濕，冰起來也無妨——請確實密封，並且讓罐子回溫再打開，免得結露把殼弄軟。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。冷凍不會傷到種子，因為它含水極少；但既然有殼保護、櫥櫃又有 6 個月，實在賺不到什麼。只有大包裝才值得占位子，請雙層裝袋並壓出空氣。
zh.thawing: 沒有東西要解凍。若冰過，請讓密封容器回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 剝開幾顆，裡面的種仁嚐起來發苦或帶腥味。
殼上有污斑、變色，或看得到霉。
罐子裡飄出潮濕的霉味。
出現絲網、穀蛾或小蟲——米蟲類很喜歡種子。
tips: 從袋子不同位置剝幾顆試過再決定整批要不要用。
最重要的是保持乾燥；罐子受潮才是它真的會壞掉的唯一途徑。
要用時才剝殼，種仁單獨放耐放程度差很多。
在罐上寫購買日期；種子放好幾個月外觀都一樣。

faq.q: 帶殼南瓜籽可以放多久？
faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，6 個月。

faq.q: 帶殼南瓜籽需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 它沒有公布冷藏期限，也不需要。殼把空氣擋在種仁外，密封罐放櫥櫃就夠了。
剝幾顆嚐種仁。油耗的種子會苦、帶點腥。殼有污斑或整罐有霉味，就該丟。
